item.name: Shift 1
item.coreObjective: Learn the reception, treatment, and shift-completion loop.
item.newMechanics: The opening cases introduce patient intake, treatment steps, and the basic camera and shutter checks.
item.activeThreats: The first cases are described as normal, scripted patients with low-pressure tutorial pacing.
item.unlockOrChange: Early guides associate the opening progression with access to the shutters and cameras. No official unlock table fixes the exact boundary.
item.recommendedPrep: Learn the reception layout, check-in flow, and treatment route before the later anomaly pressure starts.
item.rewardOrProgression: Completing a shift advances the run and pays out cash in the game's normal end-of-shift loop. No fixed payout is included.
item.recurringPattern: No recurring event timing is assigned to the tutorial row.
item.scopeNote: This row covers the named first shift, not every tutorial prompt or room interaction.
item.cardSummary: The first shift teaches the reception and treatment loop before the main anomaly pressure builds.

item.name: Shift 2
item.coreObjective: Repeat the normal care loop while the first facility and anomaly checks enter the run.
item.newMechanics: Early progression guides add facility access and the first anomaly-focused pressure around the normal treatment loop.
item.activeThreats: Normal patients remain in the loop while anomaly checks and early threat behavior begin to matter.
item.unlockOrChange: Community guides disagree on this boundary. One places the Supplies Shop and Emergency Wing after Shift 2. Another places them at the start of Shift 3. The exact unlock is intentionally unresolved.
item.recommendedPrep: Practice admitting patients, completing treatment quickly, and checking the camera before committing to a room.
item.rewardOrProgression: Completing the shift advances the numbered run and pays out cash. Exact values are omitted.
item.recurringPattern: The shift loop continues after this row. Later guides place recurring Ambulance Events on a five-shift rhythm after the first event, but that timing is not assigned here.
item.scopeNote: The shop and Emergency Wing disagreement is preserved instead of being resolved in this dataset.
item.cardSummary: The second shift moves beyond the tutorial and introduces early facility and anomaly pressure, with one important unlock boundary still disputed.

item.name: Shift 3
item.coreObjective: Move into the full treatment and emergency workflow.
item.newMechanics: Early guides describe the Taser as an early progression tool. Shop and Emergency Wing access is associated with the Shift 2/3 boundary.
item.activeThreats: Anomalies and timed emergencies begin to overlap with routine patient treatment in the early progression.
item.unlockOrChange: The Shift 2/3 facility boundary remains unresolved. Sources disagree on whether the Supplies Shop and Emergency Wing open after Shift 2 or at the start of Shift 3. No resolution is claimed here.
item.recommendedPrep: Keep treatment supplies ready, learn the facility route, and be prepared to use the Taser when the relevant emergency requires it.
item.rewardOrProgression: Completing the shift advances the run and pays cash. It also leads into the higher-pressure fourth-shift milestone.
item.recurringPattern: The shift loop continues. Later community timelines place the Ambulance Event on a five-shift recurrence after its first appearance.
item.scopeNote: This row does not claim that the disputed facilities definitely unlock at Shift 3.
item.cardSummary: The third shift adds early emergency pressure and Taser progression while leaving the shop and Emergency Wing boundary open.

item.name: Shift 4
item.coreObjective: Handle the first documented high-pressure surge while keeping normal patients moving.
item.newMechanics: The Ambulance Event becomes eligible around the fourth-shift milestone and can bring six patients into the hospital at once.
item.activeThreats: The ambulance surge can include patients on fire or in critical condition, alongside normal anomalies and treatment.
item.unlockOrChange: The Ambulance Event enters the documented shift progression around this milestone. Sources vary on the exact first trigger, so this is not a hard unlock value.
item.recommendedPrep: Keep a fire extinguisher and response tool available, and triage multiple patients quickly when an ambulance arrives.
item.rewardOrProgression: Clearing the ambulance wave is associated with a cash bonus in community guides. The exact amount is not included.
item.recurringPattern: Community guides commonly describe the event at Shift 4, then about every five shifts, but the cadence is not an official guarantee.
item.scopeNote: Event mechanics are detailed in the existing emergencies collection. This row records the progression point only.
item.cardSummary: The fourth shift is the first major pressure spike, with an Ambulance Event that can fill the hospital with urgent patients.

item.name: Shift 5
item.coreObjective: Complete the five-shift core sequence before moving into later numbered play.
item.newMechanics: Sources describe Shift 5 as the named core or tutorial-tier milestone, but they differ on whether later play should be called an ending or endless progression.
item.activeThreats: The early anomaly, enemy, treatment, and emergency loop remains active at the core milestone.
item.unlockOrChange: Shift 5 marks the end of the five-shift core sequence in the source set. It is not treated here as a hard final shift because other guides describe later numbered runs.
item.recommendedPrep: Carry the routines from earlier shifts, keep sanity recovery and emergency tools available, and do not assume every late event has a fixed shift.
item.rewardOrProgression: Some guides tie this milestone to a standard discharge or Professional Caretaker outcome, while others continue into later shifts. Preserve both descriptions until live-game verification.
item.recurringPattern: This is a milestone row, not a recurring event row. Later numbered shifts are grouped in the 6+ band.
item.scopeNote: Late story and special-shift content is outside this progression row and belongs in the relevant existing collection or article.
item.cardSummary: Shift 5 is the five-shift core milestone. The source set does not justify calling it the game's final playable shift.

item.name: Endless progression (Shift 6+)
item.coreObjective: Keep the run alive as numbered shifts continue beyond the five-shift core sequence.
item.newMechanics: Later guides describe continuing shift numbers, rising pressure, and variable late-run events instead of a fixed final row.
item.activeThreats: Recurring emergencies, broader anomaly and enemy pressure, and late story or special-shift content may appear as the run continues.
item.unlockOrChange: No fixed final shift is established in the source pass. This row groups Shift 6 and later instead of claiming one literal Shift 6 unlock.
item.recommendedPrep: Maintain a durable setup for treatment, sanity, and emergency response. Treat late timing as variable rather than memorizing a fixed table.
item.rewardOrProgression: The run continues to a higher shift number and later milestones. Exact rewards and rare event windows are left out until they have stronger support.
item.recurringPattern: Ambulance recurrences are commonly listed every five shifts after the first event, while later story and special-shift windows vary.
item.scopeNote: This is a progression band, not a claim that every later shift has identical content. Do not add temporary event rows or individual endless shift numbers here.
item.cardSummary: After the five named core shifts, later runs continue as an open-ended progression band with variable pressure and event timing.
